title: Man dies after arrest in assault of parents
article: RCMP are investigating how a man who went berserk and attacked his elderly parents early yesterday morning ended up dead after Kelowna officers arrested him.
It took five officers to restrain Derrick Madrusan, 38, after police reported to a domestic-dispute call in the Okanagan community of Westbank around 12:30.
"[The officers] attempted to restrain him from assaulting his parents, who are in their 70s," Inspector Steven Macvarnock said.

Mr. Madrusan was shackled in the police car as ambulances administered first aid to the parents for minor injuries and examined an officer for possible broken bones. Mr. Madrusan was later discovered unresponsive and pronounced dead in hospital.
